title.zh: 将奎松省 Mauban市镇奎松国立工艺学校的名称变更为Manuel S. Enverga 纪念 College of 艺术与工艺的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Quezon National School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Mauban, Province of Quezon, To Manuel S. Enverga Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Quezon National School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Mauban, Province of Quezon, To Manuel S. Enverga Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường quốc gia nghệ thuật và thủ công Quezon tại Thị trấn Mauban, Tỉnh Quezon thành Manuel S. Enverga Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนศิลปหัตถกรรมแห่งชาติ Quezon ในเทศบาล Mauban, จังหวัด Quezon เป็น Manuel S. Enverga Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Seni dan Kerajinan Nasional Quezon di Kotamadya Mauban, Provinsi Quezon menjadi Manuel S. Enverga Memorial College of Arts and Trades
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Seni dan Pertukangan Kebangsaan Quezon di Perbandaran Mauban, Wilayah Quezon menjadi Manuel S. Enverga Memorial College of Arts and Trades

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7463_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Quezon National School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Mauban, Province of Quezon, is hereby changed to Manuel S. Enverge Memorial College of Arts and Trades to honor and perpetuate the memory of the best known and most accomplished congressman produced by the province.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
